// RED fixture for `no-untagged-personal-data` — the KNOWLEDGE-relevant slice (KN-P25 / P-315).
// The lint MUST reject this. The Knowledge person record's free-text comment body field
// (`comment_text`, a PII fingerprint) carries NO #[personal_data(...)] tag — so the per-subject
// DEK crypto-shred erase (architecture knowledge-platform §6.1; KN-P26) and the RoPA/data-map
// fan-out would NOT reach it, leaving an un-erasable subject (ADR-12). The author attribution IS
// tagged here, isolating the failure to the deliberately-untagged body field.
pub struct KnowledgePersonRecord {
    pub tenant: TenantId,
    pub region: Region,
    pub artifact_id: String,
    #[personal_data(
        category = Identifier,
        role = TenantContent,
        basis = Contract,
        retention = UntilContractEnd,
        erasure = Pseudonymise,
        subject_locator = "created_by",
    )]
    pub created_by: String,
    pub comment_text: String,
}
